description: This file is a shell script used for testing CRLF (Carriage Return Line Feed) conversion mechanisms in a Git repository. It includes functions for comparing files, setting up test environments with various line ending and attribute configurations, and executing a comprehensive suite of tests to verify correct behavior of line ending normalization, Git attributes, and auto-conversion rules under different scenarios.

methods.name: compare_files
methods.description: Compares two files with CRLF or NUL replacements for line ending normalization, ensuring they are identical after transformations.

methods.name: compare_ws_file
methods.description: Compares the workspace version of files with expected line ending transformations, applying specific replacements and comparisons.

methods.name: create_gitattributes
methods.description: Creates a .gitattributes file with specified attributes for line ending normalization and text handling.

methods.name: create_NNO_MIX_files
methods.description: Generates test files with various line ending configurations and attributes to simulate different repository states for testing.

methods.name: check_warning
methods.description: Checks warning messages about line ending replacements during Git operations.

methods.name: commit_check_warn
methods.description: Performs a commit operation with specific attributes and checks for expected warnings across multiple test files.

methods.name: commit_chk_wrnNNO
methods.description: Sets up and commits files with specific attributes, then verifies warning messages related to line ending normalization.

methods.name: commit_MIX_chkwrn
methods.description: Commits files with mixed line endings and checks for expected warnings related to line ending conversions.

methods.name: stats_ascii
methods.description: Returns a string representing the line ending type for a given test parameter.

methods.name: attr_ascii
methods.description: Converts attribute flags into a human-readable string indicating line ending and text settings.

methods.name: check_files_in_repo
methods.description: Verifies that the files stored in the repository match expected line ending configurations.

methods.name: check_in_repo_NNO
methods.description: Checks that specific test files with non-normalized (NNO) line endings match expected contents.

methods.name: checkout_files
methods.description: Tests the checkout of files with various attributes and configurations, comparing the checked-out files against expected line endings and contents.
